title: Elizabeth Willmott (Purpose Trust researcher) — 'Eric Ries' book Incorruptible is also super interesting along these lines'
summary: Willmott researches the Purpose Trust model with Courtney Allen Weinstein. She cited Incorruptible as working the same ground as their research.
blockquote: The more Courtney Allen Weinstein and I have dug into the Purpose Trust model, the more complicated and worthwhile we've realized the conversation is! So much more than stewardship, values, and mission lock in corporate America — to me PTs are about how we place trust in our institutions and human relationships overall. (Eric Ries' book Incorruptible is also super interesting along these lines.)
